sections.changelog:
Changed

  • **Category badges follow the out-of-stock setting.** The number next to each category in the live dropdown now counts distinct products the same way the result list treats stock: when out-of-stock products are hidden, they are left out of the count too, so the badge matches what opening the category actually shows.

Fixed

  • **Full-screen mobile search no longer collides with a fixed bottom bar.** While the full-screen search overlay is open, the MVweb contact bar steps aside so it can no longer float over the results and hide the "show all results" action at the bottom.
  • **Clear (×) button stays centered in the field.** In the full-screen overlay the clear icon is now aligned to a fixed field height, so themes that inflate the input padding can no longer push the × below the field's centre.
